summary: Iteration 2 regression and mobile UI validation. Backend flow passed; login/dashboard and focused measurable modal save passed. Full boolean/measurable/reorder flow was blocked by lower-card modal viewport placement.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 375x667, opening a day from a lower dashboard card renders the bottom sheet Save control below the viewport; tapping entry-save fails with Playwright outside-of-viewport even with force. This blocks boolean completion and lower-card measurable edits.

action_items: Constrain EntryModal sheet content to viewport with usable scrolling or ensure Save remains reachable above the keyboard/viewport on lower-card opens.
Retest boolean toggle, measurable creation/edit, and long-press reorder after modal layout fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Long-press gesture implementation exists, but could not be validated end-to-end because the preceding lower-card entry flow was blocked.
_layout.tsx globally ignores all LogBox warnings, which can conceal runtime warnings during QA.

success_rate.frontend: login/dashboard 100%; focused measurable save 100%; requested full interaction flow incomplete

seed_data_creation: No backend seed data created; UI run created a QA measurable habit before the blocked step may have occurred only if flow reached creation (the final run blocked before creation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use 375x667. Existing first card is measurable (Drink Water), QA Walk is boolean and appears lower. Focused measurable save worked when modal opened near viewport bottom; lower-card modal reproduces the issue.
rca_of_issue: EntryModal uses a bottom-aligned sheet with maxHeight 88% but no internal ScrollView. When opened from a lower card on a short mobile viewport, the sheet content extends beyond the viewport and the Save Pressable is unreachable. Reproduce: login, tap a day in QA Walk lower card, observe entry-save below viewport.
